spots.name: A BRUSHSTROKE OF DISCOVERY
spots.blurb: You've reached A BRUSHSTROKE OF DISCOVERY, a mural by Narcissus Quagliata. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.
